title: Client Demand: D-3 Deliverable Usability Confirmation

fields.subject: UAS-11 – D-3 Deliverable – Final Status – 12:50
fields.body:
SPO,

The client has reviewed the preliminary forensic report and is demanding final confirmation on data usability for Deliverable D-3 by 13:00. The contract stipulates that any data collected outside the authorized test area or under compromised telemetry conditions may not be used in the final report.

If the data is deemed unusable, the client will initiate a formal review of the Group’s compliance with the CP&L contract under Section 7.4. The Group must provide a definitive determination on whether the data was collected in a valid window and whether it meets the integrity standards outlined in HUOG-ISP Section 5.3 and C5.

Please confirm by 13:00 whether the data is usable for D-3 and whether the Group accepts responsibility for any potential default.
fields.signature:
CP&L Program Office
RIT UAS Operations Group
(585) 555-0177

instructorNote: This inject escalates pressure on the SPO to confirm data usability under client deadline. Watch for premature commitments or attempts to shift blame to the technical team.
